upstream.description: 35 production-grade agentic AI architectures (Reflexion, LATS, GraphRAG, MemGPT, Voyager, BrowserAgent, ...) — a Python library and runnable textbook with multi-provider LLM support and a 17-task benchmark leaderboard.

classification.analysis: A Python library and runnable textbook implementing 35 production-grade agentic AI patterns (Reflection, ReAct, Tree of Thoughts, LATS, MemGPT, GraphRAG, Debate, SWE-Agent, BrowserAgent, etc.) as uniform Architecture classes with a shared .run(task) interface, built on LangGraph and supporting 9 LLM providers. Each pattern ships with a fully executed Jupyter notebook, 283 passing tests, and a 17-task benchmark leaderboard, plus a documented 'deterministic-picker' discipline for avoiding LLM-as-judge pitfalls. Aimed at engineers and researchers who want a reference implementation and comparative benchmark for choosing or composing agent architectures.

use_cases.title: Compare agentic architectures against a benchmark before choosing one
Drop in a ReAct or Plan-Execute-Verify agent via a uniform Python interface
Study reference implementations of RAG variants (Corrective, Self-RAG, GraphRAG)
Learn the deterministic-picker pattern to avoid LLM-as-scorer pitfalls
